items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 20
items.text: The spirit of AA has been with me ... for better or for worse, for richer or for poorer, in sickness and in health.
items.attribution: “Absolutely Richard,” Santa Cruz, California, April 1998, Voices of Long-Term Sobriety

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 20
items.text: Mantener la mente abierta es difícil si la boca también lo está.
items.attribution: “Destilación del espíritu”. INDIANÁPOLIS, INDIANA, AGOSTO DE 1982. Del AA Grapevine
